days.title: Southern Gateway and Highland Lakes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Hrauneyjar
stops.detail: If you travel the highland route from south to north, the path usually begins in Hrauneyjar.

stops.name: Þórisvatn
stops.detail: It is Þórisvatn, with an area between 83 and 88 km² the largest lake in Iceland and thus even larger than Þingvallavatn.

days.title: Ridges and Glacial Panoramas
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Búðarháls
stops.detail: Búðarháls is an elongated ridge, oriented from southwest to northeast, reaching a height of approx. 600–700 m and located to the west of the southern Sprengisandur track.

stops.name: Innri-Háls
stops.detail: The best view can be had from Innri-Háls (685 m), looking over 6 glaciers of Iceland.

days.title: Highland Valleys and Northern Gorges
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Nýidalur
stops.detail: To the west of Tungnafellsjökull lies the valley Nýidalur (German 'the new valley').

stops.name: Nýidalsá
stops.detail: The valley is flowed through by the river Nýidalsá.

stops.name: Kiðagil
stops.detail: Its boundaries are somewhat vague; in the south it is roughly delimited by Eyvindarver, a marshland east of the river Þjórsá (part of the Þjórsárver), in the north by the gorge Kiðagil.

stops.name: Aldeyjarfoss
stops.detail: Near the northern end of the Sprengisandur is the waterfall Aldeyjarfoss.
